cohort: The study included 450 women with a mean age of 32.14 years undergoing medical abortion.
finding: Various demographic and medical history factors, along with physical activity, significantly influence the duration, pain, bleeding, and anxiety experienced during medical abortion.
mod_finding: Prior cesarean section history was associated with less pain and anxiety during medical abortion, while prior vaginal delivery history was associated with less pain.
cross-section timing: Data was collected throughout the medical abortion process.
